name: {{BUNDLE_NAME}}
description: Coordinated access to a shared network drive for concurrent Claude agent sessions — versioned reads/writes, leases, history, and an attributable audit trail.

coord_url.title: Coordinator URL
coord_url.description: From your IT administrator, e.g. http://coord-host:8787

coord_token.title: Coordinator token
coord_token.description: From your IT administrator. Leave empty if you were not given one.

coordinated_root.title: Coordinated location
coordinated_root.description: The fileserver drive letter as X:\ or the full path to the share

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Endpoint log verbosity: error | warn | info | debug. Logs go to stderr, never the MCP channel.

tools.name: chapr_read
tools.description: Read a text file with coordinated versioning (content returned as untrusted data; binary containers are refused with advice).

tools.name: chapr_write
tools.description: Write a file with compare-and-swap; losing writes are parked in a sidecar.

tools.name: chapr_create
tools.description: Create a new file (fails if it exists).

tools.name: chapr_delete
tools.description: Soft-delete a file (snapshotted to history first).

tools.name: chapr_move
tools.description: Move/rename a file; version history moves with it.

tools.name: chapr_list
tools.description: List a directory with open-conflict counts.

tools.name: chapr_stat
tools.description: Get a file's version, journal state, and any held lease.

tools.name: chapr_restore
tools.description: Restore a historical version, as a copy by default or in place.

tools.name: chapr_conflicts
tools.description: List unreconciled conflicts under a path.

tools.name: chapr_resolve_conflict
tools.description: Record how a conflict was reconciled, for the audit trail.

tools.name: chapr_mkdir
tools.description: Create a directory; refuses a name that closely resembles an existing folder.
